label: The sub-arc that never ended
from: Arc 2 as a set of events: Rae at the BBQ, Bella and Nova found, two weddings
to: AND A QUESTION THAT OPENED A SEARCH WHICH HAS NEVER CLOSED
note:
RAE CAME BACK ALIVE, AND LIVI ASKED: IF RAE SURVIVED, DID ANYONE ELSE?

THAT IS THE GHOST HUNT, and it is THE ONLY SUB-ARC IN THIS ENTIRE CANON THAT DID NOT END WHEN ITS PARENT ARC DID. Every other thread in fifteen arcs opens, runs and resolves. This one opened in Arc 2 AND IS STILL OPEN.

ONLY THE POSTURE CHANGED. For years it meant GOING OUT LOOKING — deliberately, following every thread of a name. NOW IT RUNS IN THE BACKGROUND. Nobody stood down. Nobody declared it finished. The search became THE AMBIENT CONDITION OF THIS FAMILY rather than an expedition it mounts.

AND IT REFRAMES THE NOTEBOOK COMPLETELY. The Archive filed that ledger this evening as a record-keeping system with a moving notation. IT IS NOT A RECORD. IT IS AN OPEN CASE FILE. The circles are closed cases. THE UNCIRCLED ENTRIES ARE WHY SHE HAS NOT PUT THE BOOK DOWN IN A DECADE OF ARCS.

WHY HER. Because THE FAMILY IS HER FLOCK, and she keeps the book BECAUSE SHE ALWAYS HOPES TO GROW IT. She marries every couple on this compound for the same reason she keeps the list — both are the shepherd counting who is safely in.

SO EVERY SINGLE THING THE ARCHIVE HAD ON OLIVIA STEWART WAS ONE LAYER TOO SHALLOW. The strategist is running a search. The officiant is counting the flock. The boxing coach who counts reps has been counting SOMETHING ELSE since the academy. And ARC 2 DID NOT CONTAIN THE GHOST HUNT — it STARTED it, and the arc lens will never show it closing, because it does not.
